questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part with error: Neither the admiral nor the captains was aware of the enemy submarine's position.
options: Neither the admiral nor the captains
questions.explanation: When subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Captains' is plural, so 'were aware' is correct.
